validation_notes: Processed 10 CSV rows and 9 unique identities; Леонид Михельсон appeared in two non-identical CSV forms and was merged into the CEO record with both executive and board roles. Checked 2 local documents in MOEXBMI_Отчеты_2024/NVTK: the 2024 annual report and 2024 disclosable consolidated financial statements. Completed 1 research round for each unique person. Weak or auxiliary sources were used only where primary sources lacked earlier career detail: Neftegaz.RU and MarketScreener for Наталенко's earlier career, Runetbook only as auxiliary for Орел, Vedomosti/Roscongress/HSE for public professional biographies. A conflict was found for Алексей Орел: some 2024 news sources used patronymic "Витальевич"; official NOVATEK candidate information confirms "Владимирович", so the conflicting patronymic was rejected. No verified h-index values were included. Search is considered complete because local documents were checked first, official NOVATEK documents were reviewed, education and prior experience were searched separately for each person, obvious namesake risks were checked, and subsequent search passes did not produce higher-quality contradictory or additional facts for 2024. ROUND 2 (quality pass, 2026-07-31): verified on-disk file against git HEAD baseline -- byte-identical, no regression to restore. No genuine notes-vs-JSON inconsistencies found (round 1 notes for every person matched the JSON exactly; all identity conflicts, e.g. Орел's patronymic and Киде/Кид spelling, had already been resolved within round 1 itself). Fixed 7 internally-inconsistent qualification_degree nulls by applying the exact same classification convention already used for identical Russian degree titles (Кандидат/Доктор X наук, экономист-математик, магистр экономики, MBA, инженер-X) across dozens of other tickers in this corpus: Михельсон (Инженер-строитель), Наталенко (инженер-геолог), Крюков (экономист-математик; Доктор экономических наук), Орел (Кандидат геолого-минералогических наук), Гайда (магистр экономики; MBA). Resolved the honest gap on Нестеренко's education: fresh queries (via direct page fetch, not the exhausted WebSearch budget) found Rosnedra's official page and lawtek.ru independently confirming 1993 MGIMO International Law Faculty graduation; added with Specialist degree. GICS professional_experience: added Energy/Energy/Oil, Gas & Consumable Fuels to all ПАО "НОВАТЭК" entries (the profiled company itself, already known at top level), Materials/Materials/Chemicals to both ПАО "СИБУР Холдинг" entries, Financials/Banks/Banks to Газпромбанк, Energy/Energy/Oil, Gas & Consumable Fuels to Газпром/Роснефть/Татнефть, Industrials/Commercial & Professional Services/Professional Services to Киде's three EY entries, and Communication Services/Media & Entertainment/Media to Нестеренко's ООО "ПравоТЭК" (confirmed via RusProfile/RBC registry lookup: primary ОКВЭД is publishing). Left АО "РОСНЕФТЕГАЗ" (pure state holding, no operating business), all ministries, ГЭС-2 (nonprofit cultural center), research institutes (ИЭОПП СО РАН, ВНИГНИ), and associations/foundations (Российское газовое общество, Ассоциация "Женщины в энергетике", Franco-Russian CCI, Фонд/Школа управления "Сколково", Сколтех) correctly null/non-classifiable. IMPORTANT CONSTRAINT THIS ROUND: the session's shared WebSearch budget (200/200) was already exhausted by earlier tickers in this batch before NVTK was reached; honest-gap follow-up used WebFetch against direct URLs (official sites, DuckDuckGo HTML results, business registries) instead. Крюков's h_index and the education-qualification wording for Феодосьев/Орел/Акимов, and the GICS classification of Издательство "Нестор Академик" / ООО "СПРИНТ" / ООО "Центр Низкоуглеродного Развития", were attempted with fresh queries but remain unresolved -- see research_notes/NVTK/quality_pass_round1_20260731.md for the exact queries tried and why each was inconclusive (mainly: no indexed Scopus/eLibrary profile for Крюков; ambiguous or unconfirmed identity match for the two LLCs; rate-limiting on the SPRINT registry lookup).
